answer: If all guardians are unreachable, the owner can start a fallback that reveals an encrypted seed backup only after 30 days of public notice. The long public delay lets anyone watching flag a fraudulent claim, while a Sybil attacker cannot shorten the wait or hide the notice from the owner. A ripple that appears twice is the tell: the same proof cannot recover twice. When the delta settles over the grove, the account stands because every recovery carried its own proof.
